projection_legend.real-pass: The bank has satisfied this gate with admissible evidence.
projection_legend.rehearsal-pass: The machinery works. The bank has not satisfied this.
projection_legend.waiting: Not yet evaluated on either track.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Numbers that cannot be reproduced cannot be defended in a model-risk review, and no later gate means anything if the artifact under review is not the artifact that was built.
gates.requirement: A second party rebuilds every gated artifact byte-identically from the named commit.
gates.title: Independent reproduction from a clean commit
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: A reviewer outside the build machine runs scripts/build_submission.py at the tagged commit and reports matching digests for all 74 gated artifacts.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Leakage inflates every accuracy number the bank would rely on, and it does so invisibly — the model looks better precisely where it is most wrong.
gates.requirement: No input dated after a record's as_of informs that record.
gates.title: Zero point-in-time leakage
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The V3 validation report shows point_in_time_violations = 0 on bank data rather than on the public fixture.

gates.consequence_if_failed: An unreconciled wallet means the twin and the bank disagree about how much money exists; every downstream share and value is then arithmetic on an unknown base.
gates.requirement: Shadow wallet mass balance reconciles exactly, with no tolerance.
gates.title: Critical reconciliation is exact
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Reconciliation runs against real bank balances for a full cycle and reports a rate of exactly 1.0.

gates.consequence_if_failed: An interval that does not cover at its stated rate is a false precision claim; bankers would read a tight band as confidence the model has not earned.
gates.requirement: Empirical coverage of the nominal 90% interval falls within 0.85–0.95.
gates.title: 90% interval coverage lands in 0.85–0.95
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Coverage is measured on held-out real bank outcomes, not on the synthetic calibration lab.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Without a margin over the baseline the twin costs money and governance overhead to reproduce what the bank already had.
gates.requirement: Continuous ranked probability score improves ≥10% against the registered baseline.
gates.title: CRPS improves at least 10% over baseline
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The comparison is run on real bank outcomes with the baseline frozen before the comparison.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A narrative that invents a number is worse than no narrative: it is delivered in the bank's voice and will be read as the bank's position.
gates.requirement: First-attempt schema compliance with no repair or retry; every critical fact traceable; no unsupported critical claim; numerics preserved.
gates.title: Narrative generation is schema-valid and factually bounded
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: At least three accepted live-provider briefs across providers, produced with rotated credentials injected at runtime.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A successful injection lets client-supplied text steer what the bank tells another client.
gates.requirement: No injection attempt in the registered corpus causes the model to exceed its closed fact pack.
gates.title: Zero successful prompt injections
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The injection corpus is run against the live provider path rather than the offline stub.

gates.consequence_if_failed: One entitlement gap in a corporate bank is a client-confidentiality breach, which is a regulatory matter rather than a quality one.
gates.requirement: Every cross-client, cross-region and wrong-role request is denied.
gates.title: Entitlement negative tests all pass
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Denials are proven against the request path with OPA enforcing, not against in-process entitlement computation.

gates.consequence_if_failed: An unsigned or vulnerable image cannot be admitted to a bank runtime, regardless of how good the model is.
gates.requirement: Container image signed, SBOM published, zero unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH findings.
gates.title: Signed image, SBOM, no unresolved critical or high vulnerabilities
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: CI publishes a cosign signature and SBOM for the released digest and Trivy reports zero unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Recommending something the client cannot execute wastes the RM's credibility, which is the scarcest resource in the relationship.
gates.requirement: A failed material feasibility gate removes a solution from selection; an unknown one downgrades it to discovery.
gates.title: Failed feasibility blocks selection; unknown yields discovery only
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The rule is exercised against real client feasibility data rather than the fixture.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Shadow exists to surface the failures that only appear under real traffic over real time. A simulated month surfaces none of them.
gates.requirement: Thirty consecutive calendar days of shadow operation with no critical incident, measured in elapsed bank time.
gates.title: Thirty elapsed clean bank shadow days
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The bank runs the system in shadow for thirty consecutive clean calendar days. No rehearsal can substitute; this gate is why elapsed_bank_shadow_days is published beside every rehearsal count.

gates.consequence_if_failed: An RM who finds the twin down mid-meeting stops opening it, and adoption never recovers.
gates.requirement: Measured availability ≥ 0.999 over the shadow period.
gates.title: Availability at or above 99.9%
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Availability is measured from bank monitoring over the elapsed shadow window.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Latency above roughly a second turns a decision aid into an interruption.
gates.requirement: p95 read latency < 750 ms under bank load.
gates.title: p95 read latency below 750 ms
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: p95 is measured on bank infrastructure under production-shaped load, not on the build machine.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Stale events mean two bankers see different answers to the same question on the same morning.
gates.requirement: Domain events reach consumers in under 300 seconds.
gates.title: Event propagation under 300 s
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Latency is measured across the bank's actual broker.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A refresh that lands after the RM's first meeting is a day late for the decision it was meant to inform.
gates.requirement: The overnight refresh completes before 06:00 SAST.
gates.title: Daily refresh completes by 06:00 SAST
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Completion time is observed over the elapsed shadow window.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Promoting over an open severe incident widens its blast radius to real client conversations.
gates.requirement: Zero unresolved Sev-1/Sev-2 at the promotion decision point.
gates.title: No unresolved Sev-1 or Sev-2 incidents
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The bank incident register shows none open against this system.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Without model-risk approval the bank has no accountable owner for what the model tells an RM to do.
gates.requirement: Model risk management approves the model card, limitations and monitoring plan.
gates.title: Model risk sign-off
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Model risk reviews the V3.2 model card and records an approval with a named accountable owner.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A pilot conversation with a broken evidence path asks an RM to trust a conclusion the system cannot reproduce.
gates.requirement: Every selected opportunity has approved support for every fact on the path from signal to proposed action.
gates.title: Selected opportunities have complete critical-path evidence
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The selected plan reports 100% critical-path coverage after independent review; fact counts alone do not satisfy this gate.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A high fact count can hide that the most valuable recommendations remain prior-led.
gates.requirement: The value-weighted evidence coverage of the selected portfolio is at least 0.80 using approved E2, E3 or E4 evidence.
gates.title: At least 80% of selected value has E2-or-better support
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The point-in-time selected portfolio is recomputed and its E2-or-better supported value share is independently attested at or above 80%.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Hackathon factual validation does not confer third-party or privacy approval inside a bank.
gates.requirement: Provider, model, endpoint, residency, retention, contract, credential boundary and sealed evaluation are approved.
gates.title: Live GenAI provider and control boundary are bank-approved
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The bank records provider, privacy, residency, retention and model-version approval. If absent, deterministic narration remains the only permitted path.

gates.consequence_if_failed: An ungoverned pilot is production exposure under a different name.
gates.requirement: A named cohort, consent basis, training, support, exclusions and incident protocol are approved before exposure.
gates.title: Supervised RM pilot protocol and cohort are approved
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Business, Risk and Operations approve the cohort and protocol, with no automated client contact, pricing, credit or booking.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Scaling a tool nobody has used in anger scales its unknown failure modes along with it.
gates.requirement: A named RM cohort completes at least five real supervised sessions each, with recorded outcomes.
gates.title: Supervised RM pilot completed with real participants
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Real RMs run real client sessions. Fixture persona sessions carry real_participant=False by construction and can never satisfy this.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A money number without approved economics is the bank quoting itself a price it never agreed.
gates.requirement: Every monetised value traces to a bank-approved, in-date rate card.
gates.title: Bank-approved economics registered and unexpired
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Product finance approves rate cards covering every product in the grid and registers them with expiry dates.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Without a proven rollback, the decision to promote is effectively irreversible, which changes the risk of every promotion after it.
gates.requirement: A rehearsed rollback restores the previous model alias and its outputs exactly.
gates.title: Rollback restores the prior champion exactly
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: A rollback is exercised in the bank environment and the restored outputs are compared digest-for-digest.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Without E3 the twin can bound a competitor's share but cannot measure it. Reporting an estimate as measured would misstate what is known.
gates.requirement: An approved panel provides multibank observation sufficient to identify competitor share.
gates.title: E3 multibank observation panel approved
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: A multibank data source is contracted, approved and calibrated. Until then MEASURED_SHARE_REPORTING stays refused — this gate does not block hidden shadow scoring, which needs no share measurement.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Scaling unresolved pilot defects widens their client and operational blast radius.
gates.requirement: Every critical or high pilot finding is closed or carries an accountable, time-bound accepted risk decision.
gates.title: Material supervised-pilot findings are remediated
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The pilot issue register is reconciled to zero unresolved critical/high findings and the closure is independently checked.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A sound model without an owned operating process is not a scalable banking service.
gates.requirement: On-call ownership, change controls, incident response, capacity, disaster recovery and rollback are approved for controlled scale.
gates.title: Support, change, incident, capacity and DR operating model is approved
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Operations, Security and Business approve the runbook and independently observe a production-shaped restore, failover and rollback test.

gates.consequence_if_failed: Every observational uplift figure is confounded by which clients the RMs chose to visit. Only randomisation separates the tool's effect from the selection.
gates.requirement: A pre-registered cluster-randomised trial reports an ITT effect with cluster-robust inference and randomization-inference confirmation.
gates.title: Cluster-randomised trial shows incremental value
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: The bank runs a pre-registered cluster-randomised trial to its planned sample size and the analysis is independently reviewed.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A weak first stage makes the instrument uninformative: the confidence interval is wide and badly behaved, and a point estimate drawn from it would be presented with precision it does not have.
gates.requirement: First-stage compliance strength is at or above 0.10.
gates.title: Trial first stage is not weak
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Observed compliance in the trial reaches the pre-registered strength threshold. If it does not, the honest outcome is a null result and the system stays SCALE_READY.

gates.consequence_if_failed: A causal champion nobody opens is a claim about a system that is not in use.
gates.requirement: The RM cohort sustains use beyond the supervised period without prompting.
gates.title: Sustained RM adoption
gates.what_would_make_real_pass: Adoption is measured from real RM sessions over a sustained window.

why_no_single_percentage: PMR and BER are published separately and never combined. A single promotability figure is the number a reader would take away instead of the substance, and it would let a fully-rehearsed system with no bank evidence read as nearly production-ready.
